+class ReplayStorage:
+    """Freeze only when a consuming continuation would overwrite saved state."""
+    def __init__(self, owners):
+        self.owners=owners
+        self.frozen=False
+
+    def freeze(self):
+        if not self.frozen:
+            self.owners=tuple(x.clone() for x in self.owners)
+            self.frozen=True
+

 class Replay(torch.autograd.Function):
